Game Overview

In Hanuka, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling 2D platforming adventure as a swift, athletic heroine in Hanuka. Collect elusive red balls while evading spikes, airborne foes, and rotating blades across eight adrenaline-pumping levels. Master the art of double jumps to conquer intricate challenges and progress through this captivating quest.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Hanuka is easy to pick up. Embark on a thrilling 2D platforming adventure as a swift, athletic heroine in Hanuka. Master the art of double jumps to conquer intricate challenges and progress through this captivating quest.
